Use [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) as the single source of truth for all repository instructions.

For issue work, use [.github/skills/libs/SKILL.md](skills/libs/SKILL.md) to route the issue's hidden workflow marker to the canonical documents and skills under `skills/`.

`.github/prompts/` contains Copilot Chat command adapters. It is not the Copilot cloud agent workflow router.
